title: vertical-v2 input
description: One vertical-v2 run's input, closed at every level (references/back-loop.md section 3; references/vertical-contract.md section 4). The owner's words a run carries (a collapsed gate, a committed-state-only order, a base he gave) arrive verbatim under station.owner_words; the ask's answer arrives later through `ask --answer`, never here.

input_version.description: the bump path a closed schema needs

run_id.description: this run's own id, single-use, one path segment

workspace.description: absolute path of the git work tree the core reads

run_dir.description: absolute path of this run's directory, outside the workspace

report_only.description: the run writes nothing outside its run directory

invocation.description: filled by the adapter's invocation.py, never typed

harness.description: the harness this run is driven from

session_id.description: the session this run happens in, as the adapter read it from the harness's own record

depth.description: the depth the executor states before launch: LEAN (spec, correctness, seams) or DEEP (adds security and tests)

session_model.description: the model id this session's system prompt says it is powered by; rides on the local claude-session requests

date.description: the verdict doc's date; absent, today's UTC date

owner_words.description: the owner's own words in this run, verbatim; the one source of a collapse, an order or a base

collapse_gate.description: the owner's invocation words that collapse the gate (a slice short of signed off proceeds); recorded in the Method line

committed_only.description: the owner's order to review committed state though dirt touches the boundary or the build doc; recorded in the Method line

base.description: the owner's answer to the base question, used only when neither the doc nor the merge base gives one
